item.title: AI + 专业服务出海
item.summary: External evidence does not support the claim that compute, model, agent and professional services can be exported as a universally plug-and-play package. The strongest current operating model is a versioned country production blueprint whose eligibility, delivery assets, production acceptance, recurring usage, renewal and fully loaded contribution are tracked in one cohort ledger. AWS has the strongest public evidence chain, but no player discloses comparable renewed country economics.

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: The market is likely to move from product bundles toward governed country blueprints and tiered delivery networks. Advantage should accrue to players that reduce delivery time and local cost across repeated deployments while preserving recurring platform usage and renewal; public evidence is not yet sufficient to name a profitability winner.
synthesis.strategic_summary: External evidence does not support the claim that compute, model, agent and professional services can be exported as a universally plug-and-play package. The strongest current operating model is a versioned country production blueprint whose eligibility, delivery assets, production acceptance, recurring usage, renewal and fully loaded contribution are tracked in one cohort ledger. AWS has the strongest public evidence chain, but no player discloses comparable renewed country economics.
synthesis.why_now: Vendors are moving simultaneously into local regions, managed agent runtimes, partner certification and packaged industry solutions. This creates a window to separate genuinely reusable production systems from subsidized bespoke projects before partner counts and product catalogs become misleading scale proxies.
winner_conditions: At least two comparable country cohorts reach production and first renewal.
Blueprint reuse lowers delivery hours and time-to-production without weakening outcome or governance.
Recurring platform contribution plus services contribution covers fixed country cost.
Partner qualification predicts production references and measurable outcomes.

evidence.source_quote: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is the platform to build, connect, and optimize AI agents. With AgentCore, you can deploy agents using any framework and model with production-grade security from day one, connect agents to enterprise systems, tools, and data with automatic authentication and access controls, and continuously optimize agent performance with tracing, debugging, and evaluation capabilities built in. AgentCore capabilities are designed to work together or independently, giving you the flexibility to adopt what you need, when you need it — no infrastructure management required.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Bedrock is the managed model and agent layer of AWS's integrated stack; its production controls and serverless consumption rail are necessary but not sufficient for repeat delivery.

evidence.source_quote: Provide customized ChatGPT to citizens. This will help deliver improved healthcare and education, more efficient public services, and more. This will be AI of, by, and for the needs of each particular country, localized in their language and for their culture and respecting future global standards.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: OpenAI for Countries explicitly bundles local infrastructure, localized products, startup investment and government partnership, providing a model-first integrated export archetype.

evidence.source_quote: Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage should be roughly 64%, down year-over-year driven by continued investments in AI and increased GitHub Copilot usage. Just this week we announced a business model transition in GitHub Copilot that will align pricing with usage and value that takes effect on June 1st of this year.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Microsoft's earnings call anchors cloud and AI demand, capacity and margin boundaries at company level but does not disclose overseas integrated-service cohort economics.

evidence.source_quote: Better field alignment and co-sell: Google Cloud has been co-selling with partners since our inception. Now, we’re introducing new processes to better capture and share partners' critical contributions with our sales team. This includes increased visibility into the highly valuable co-selling activities like workshops, assessments, and proofs-of-concept, as well as partner-delivered services for migrations, application modernization, and other managed services. Ultimately, this information will better enable our sales team to connect customers with the correct ISV and services partners.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google describes an agentic partner operating model that separates platform control from industry implementation and distribution.

evidence.source_quote: In a previous post on the Public Sector Blog , we covered six key strategies in which Amazon Web Services (AWS) empowers AWS Partners to expand their platforms globally to reach more customers while meeting requirements such as data residency and sovereignty. These ranged from using AWS Global Infrastructure to AWS services that make it easier for partners to implement requirements consistently. In this post, we consolidate those steps into a framework that can guide partners to plan for expansion, design their architecture, and deploy their platforms into a new AWS Region while navigating critical decisions.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS documents market-entry dimensions across Europe and the Middle East, showing that country expansion requires regulatory and operating readiness beyond product availability.

evidence.source_quote: Google Cloud Marketplace is moving to a variable revenue share model , with revenue share from 3% to as low as 1.5% for eligible partners and deals based on attributes such as deal size, renewal, channel shift, or migrations. This update will enable partners to improve deal economics and to retain more earnings.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google Marketplace documents co-sell, channel-private-offer and billing rails that can convert partner-delivered AI into repeatable procurement.

evidence.source_quote: Jabil has also accelerated the development of generative AI solutions using Amazon Q, such as the intelligent shop floor assistant. The first iteration of the shop floor assistant was built in just one week, with additional data sources integrated over the following weeks to enable the chatbot to access relevant documents, incident tickets, and knowledge articles from multiple systems. Since its launch, the solution has provided employees globally with real-time access to over 1,700 policies, manufacturing specifications, and troubleshooting documents in various languages, significantly reducing average troubleshooting time and improving diagnostic accuracy for floor operators.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Jabil is a multinational production case showing that industry workflows, data integration and organizational adoption must accompany the cloud and model layer.

evidence.source_quote: In March, we launched the Claude Partner Network—a program, backed by a $100 million investment in partner training, technical support, and shared marketing, for the firms that help enterprises put Claude into production. Since then, more than 40,000 firms have applied to join and more than 10,000 consultants have earned a Claude certification—a credential, held by an individual, that signals they've been trained to build and deploy Claude in production.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic defines a services track, enablement resources and partner requirements that aim to make model-led transformation repeatable.

evidence.source_quote: Successful organizations tend to share several characteristics. They establish clear executive accountability for measurable outcomes linked to AI adoption. Rather than prioritizing short-term stability, they align incentives with workflow evolution. By integrating AI directly into operational systems, they aren’t left to rely on disconnected standalone tools. And they define governance boundaries clearly enough that employees understand how AI should be used.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Practitioner-oriented reporting identifies workflow and organizational barriers that remain outside a standard compute-model-agent bundle.

evidence.source_quote: A significant proportion of our $100 million investment will go directly to our partners as direct support for training and sales enablement, and for market development (including work to make customer deployments successful) and co-marketing for joint campaigns and events. We’re also scaling our partner-facing team fivefold, so that we can provide dedicated Applied AI engineers to partners working on live customer deals, technical architects to scope more complex implementations, and localized go-to-market support in international markets.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic discloses the investment and incentives behind a model-first services channel, while leaving customer-level repeat economics undisclosed.

evidence.source_quote: The AWS AI Competency represents the highest level of validation for Partners working with autonomous AI systems. Partners undergo rigorous technical assessment and must demonstrate successful customer implementations that align with AWS’ commitment to responsible AI development.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS defines validated partner roles for agentic applications and infrastructure, showing how a cloud vendor can standardize part of the overseas delivery stack.

evidence.source_quote: Over 1,400 Accenture engineers will be trained as specialists in using Anthropic’s models on AWS, allowing them to provide customers with end-to-end support that accelerates their AI strategies from concept to production. Accenture’s engineers will help organizations use their own data to fine-tune Anthropic’s models on AWS to enhance performance for their use case and industry. Teams across Accenture and AWS will also guide customers on prompt and platform engineering to help them deploy AI models through Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: The Anthropic, AWS and Accenture collaboration is an explicit three-party compute-model-services archetype, including training and enterprise deployment commitments.

evidence.source_quote: Despite what you may have read in the media, consulting is not being entirely consumed by artificial intelligence. Yes, the economic paradox of professional services in the AI computing era is that business and technology consultants can use AI-powered delivery platforms to do more work at lower cost . That puts pressure on service provider margins, reduces the need for more headcount, and forces a reconciliation between what enterprise buyers need and what service providers have historically offered.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent consulting analysis describes the shift from labor-heavy projects toward AI-enabled services and outcome accountability; it is directional, not player financial proof.

evidence.source_quote: Honestly, you getting a lead or a referral is a networking/connections game. The field teams preference for partners is tribal, there is no systematic program to feed partners.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: This practitioner thread is retained only as a low-grade signal that formal partner status may not create leads or support; it is not a company fact.

evidence.source_quote: RAKBANK’s transformation required not just the right technology but also the right support to implement it effectively. “Our partnership with Microsoft has been critical to the success of these AI programs. One of the biggest advantages was Microsoft’s ability to offer AI capability in the local cloud here in the UAE. Without this, data sovereignty regulations might have prevented us from leveraging AI at all,” shares Saith.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: RAKBANK is a regulated UAE production case joining Azure AI, enterprise data, implementation and measured operational results.

evidence.source_quote: Team members can use Amazon Q Developer for assistance with code generation, testing, and debugging. They can also get help with business questions, their code base, and other topics related to enterprise data. Using the service, DTCC engineers can transform and implement new code to meet their specific requests. During the POC, the company boosted developer throughput by 40 percent, accelerating product development by saving many hours a week. “During our POCs, we found that something that used to take 10 hours now takes 6 hours using Amazon Q Developer,” says Powell. “That is quite powerful.” The company also reduced code defects and the associated operational risks by 30 percent while improving test coverage during the POC. Throughout the use of Amazon Q Developer, build-failure rates did not increase.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: DTCC is a production case connecting AWS infrastructure, Amazon Q, implementation work and a measured development-cycle result.

evidence.source_quote: Turki Badhris, President of Microsoft Arabia, added: “Confirming that customers will be able to run cloud workloads from our Saudi Arabia East datacenter region in Q4 2026 provides organizations with clarity and confidence as they plan their digital and AI journeys. Across Saudi Arabia, we are working closely with government entities, enterprises, and partners to support readiness – from data modernization and governance to skills development – so customers can move from experimentation to production with confidence. This milestone reflects our long-term commitment to enabling meaningful, scalable impact for the Kingdom’s public and private sectors.”
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Microsoft's Saudi region announcement establishes a local infrastructure and partner precondition but does not itself prove production, renewal or unit economics.

evidence.source_quote: Alibaba Cloud worked with 6Estates’ Technical Team to design and deploy the solution and has provided ongoing support and guidance in the operation of the solution after it went live.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 6Estates is a cross-border customer case joining regional deployment, marketplace access and ongoing technical support, while renewal economics remain undisclosed.

evidence.source_quote: As part of the scheme, the duo will provide firms with a suite of six industry-specific agentic AI solutions designed to help push projects from pilot to production.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent reporting says projects stall on skills, data and operating change, limiting any claim that a packaged technical stack is plug-and-play.
